title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation of the Posterior Parietal Cortex in Patients Suffering From Gilles de la Tourette Syndrome
design: Active/sham crossover posterior-parietal rTMS; participant/outcome-assessor masking. Structured allocation non-randomized conflicts with narrative randomized wording.
population: Adults aged 18-70 eligible with Tourette syndrome, premonitory sensations and registry-stated YGTSS 30-60, subscale unspecified.
outcomes: Registry-listed YGTSS at 3 months; no numerical outcomes posted.
key_result: Registry stopping reason is lack of efficacy; no posted results. This is a registrant statement, not an effect estimate.
uncertainty: Very small sample, unresolved design wording, no outcome precision, harms, attrition or primary results publication in inspected record. Historical field-change API returned 403.
inference_not_supported: The study newly failed in October 2026; all rTMS targets/protocols are ineffective; a quantified treatment effect, disease modification or cure.
adverse_events: Not reported in the inspected registry results because no results are posted.
retrieval_status: Official current API record inspected. Cached official search rendering showed old terminated status, but full authoritative version-history diff unavailable.
next_verification_task: Before using in an efficacy synthesis, locate any primary outcomes/methods report and verify historical field changes and study overlap; do not treat as a new clinical result.
